ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} According to the graph, the coordinates of the intersection point of the two lines are $(-2, 3)$,

$\therefore$ the solution set of the inequality ${k}_{2}x<{k}_{1}x+5$ is $\boxed{x>-2}$.
